title: Starlow! 💫
description: A guiding light joins the adventure once again! ✨
body:
From Mario & Luigi: Bowser’s Inside Story, **Starlow**, the spirited star who aids **Mario, Luigi, and Princess Peach**, now arrives in **Minecraft!** 💛


This **resource pack** transforms the **Allay** into **Starlow**, featuring:


🌠 A completely new **model and texture** faithful to her original design


🔊 Custom **sounds and voice lines** inspired by her in-game personality


💎 A gentle, glowing presence that perfectly captures her charm and energy


Let **Starlow** guide you through your Minecraft adventures — with all her wit and star power! 🌌


**///About Mod///**

This is an altered version of the original model made by Mojang of the Allay,
which replaces him with Starlow.

[https://discord.com/invite/pQnwM4gu8M](https://discord.com/invite/pQnwM4gu8M)

-Custom texture pack (x16)

-Models made in Blockbench

-Download the required packs for non missing textures

-Inspiration straight from Mario and Luigi Bowser Inside Story



#MarioMania #Starlow #MinecraftMods #ResourcePack #MarioAndLuigi #BowserInsideStory
